_comment: Contract map for TOOFAN model artifacts. METADATA-ONLY documentation of every known artifact and its real data requirements. This map does NOT alter runtime behaviour and does NOT register anything into registry_index.json (registration remains a deliberate, verified action). The dependency graph in pipeline DEFAULT_DEPENDENCIES is intentionally conservative vs. these true requirements: module X may be scheduled after upstreams even as a placeholder.

genesis.input_contract: environmental features (SST, 850/700/500/200 hPa T/R, u850/u200/v850/v200, vertical wind shear) at genesis time
genesis.note: Adapter supports raw_model/metadata construction (`src/models/genesis/adapter.py`); registration deferred to avoid flipping runtime statuses in verified integration tests.

trajectory.known_limitation: adapter requires the `inference` deployment package, absent in repo (pre-existing ModuleNotFoundError); module currently UNAVAILABLE through the orchestrator.

intensity.note: No verified artifact present; module stays honestly UNAVAILABLE.

ri.input_contract: 12 IMD features (lat, lon, wind/pressure + 6/12/24h deltas); fusion branch adds ERA5 predictor fields per feature spec
ri.runtime_status: registered (v1; ri_fusion v1 as separate entry)

rainfall.input_contract: IMERG precipitation time series (FANI case study)

wind.input_contract: 6 temporal frames x 81x57 grid x 2 channels (U10, V10 in m/s); documented normalization wind/metadata/wind_normalization.txt
wind.runtime: src/models/wind/adapter.py (TF isolated in subprocesses; orchestrator does NOT hot-load .keras in main process)
wind.known_limitation: Yaas 2021 case study; no gridded U10/V10 provider ships in repo; no calibrated confidence.

flood.input_contract: accumulated rainfall + terrain (dem.tif missing in repo -> DEM source NOT_AVAILABLE)

recurvature.known_limitation: adapter requires `inference` deployment package, absent in repo (pre-existing ModuleNotFoundError).
